newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Boutros-Ghali says Iraqi tensions hinder aid plans.
newsitem.headline: Boutros-Ghali says Iraqi tensions hinder aid plans.

text.p: U.N. Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali Tuesday expressed concern over the tensions in Iraq, saying recent events will hamper efforts to implement the oil-for-food humanitarian aid program.

"Secretary General Boutros Boutros-Ghali is concerned over the impact of the latest events which clearly will adversely affect the implementation of our programs for humanitarian assistance," the statement from the U.N. spokesman said.
Recent Iraqi incursions into the northern, Kurdish regions of the country, and the U.S. punishment bombings on Tuesday, will effect implementation of the oil-for-food accord, the statement said.

"The Secretary-General hopes that tensions will quickly subside so that we can get on with our work of alleviating the suffering which affects all segments of the Iraqi population," the statement said.
